:::{#exr-epe-split-noise}
#### Separate the noise

Suppose that, given $\newpredvar = \predvar$,
the new outcome is $\newoutvar = \mean(\predvar) + \noise$,
where the noise $\noise$ has mean $0$ and variance $\varpar$,
and that $\newoutvar$ is independent of the random [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$.
Take every expectation below to be conditional on $\newpredvar = \predvar$.
Add and subtract $\mean(\predvar)$ inside the square of the [expected squared prediction error](#def-epe),

$$
\E{\sqf{\newoutvar - \fitproc\paren{\predvar; \trainset}}},
$$ {#eq-epe-target}

expand it, and take the expectation term by term.

Two of the three terms simplify.
Say what each becomes,
and name the assumption that makes the cross term zero.

:::
